summary_en: ¥34/share (¥1 increase from ¥33); payout ratio 83.6% for FY9/26. Record date moved to 31 October (from end-September) following shift of annual shareholder meeting to January.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ended September 2026 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Atrae Inc. announced on 10 June 2026 a dividend increase for the fiscal year ending September 2026. The board resolved to raise the annual dividend per share by ¥1 to ¥34 (previously forecast at ¥33). The revised dividend will be paid in full at the end of the fiscal year (record date 31 October 2026). The expected payout ratio for the period is 83.6%. The company cited improved financial results disclosed on the same date and a stated commitment to enhance shareholder returns while continuing to invest in new business deployment, expansion, and efficiency gains. Additionally, the record date and shareholder meeting voting base date have been shifted from end-September to 31 October to facilitate constructive shareholder engagement; the annual shareholder meeting will henceforth be held in January each year.
